main_text.p: דול Ch.Situla, urna, Jesa.40.15. Syr. ܐܘܠܦ[?] Joh.4.11. Plur.Ch. דולין Esth.1.3. in Targ.sec. Hebr. דלי.
דום Hebr.Siluit, obmutuit. Hinc Ithpahel Ch.ex litteris geminatis ידמדמון Conticescent, Exod.15.16. in Targ.Hierosol.

דין Ch. & Syr. Judicare, dijudicare, judicium exercere, Caussam agere, litigare, disceptare, contendere, Pahel דין Idem. Ithpehal אתדין Judicari. Ithpah. אדין Judicare:Litigare, disceptare, cōtendere.
דינא דין Ch.&Syr.Judex. Plur.דינין Judices, Causidici, Caussarum cognitores.

דינא דין Ch. & Syr. Judicium, caussa, contentio, lis: synecdochicè nonnunquam in N.T. pro judicio ultimo & extremo, quod in Targum vocatur דינא רבא Judicium magnum, Deut.32.34. in T.Hierosol. Psal.50.3. Plur. דינין, דינייא.
מדינתא, מדינא Ch. & Syr. Provincia, Regio: Item Civitas, Urbs, magna proprie, ܡܕܝܢܬܐ[?] Decapolis, nomen loci, Mar.5.20. Plur. מדינתא, מדינן.
דוע ܣܘܕܪ[?] Syr. Sudor, ܣܘܕܪܐ[?] Et fuit sudor ejus, Luc.22.24. Ab Hebraeo זיעה.
דיץ Ch. Lætari, gaudere, exultare, exsilire, gestire præ gaudio. Sic Syr. ܥܠܙ[?] Exultavit infans, Lucæ 1.41.44. & 6.23.
דיצא דיץ, דין Ch. Gaudium, lætitia, exsultatio, Jesa.32.14. Vide quoque infrà in דין.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and some vowel points are uncertain in several places; the Syriac words in the first entry and the Syriac forms in entries 8 and 9 are doubtful and transcribed approximately. The Hebrew in the entry Plur. דינייא is read from a small scan and may be inexact. No margin notes are printed.
